Gold.name: Gold
Gold.description: The settlement's lifeblood. Every coin is soaked in sweat—workers claw it from the earth, then hand it back for permission to build tomorrow.

Wood.name: Wood
Wood.description: The forest's quiet gift. From hasty lean-tos to towering vaults, every great structure begins among these silent rings.

Stone.name: Stone
Stone.description: The slumbering bones of the world. After eons of stillness, they are chiseled, hauled, and stacked—becoming the settlement's unyielding skeleton.

IronOre.name: Iron Ore
IronOre.description: Dark-red veins threading the mountainside. Crude, heavy, devoid of shine—yet these are the first heartbeats of an iron civilization.

CopperOre.name: Copper Ore
CopperOre.description: The oldest industrial metal. Once it belonged only to bronze statues and ancient bells—now it carries electric current into every fiber of the settlement.

AluminumOre.name: Aluminum Ore
AluminumOre.description: A silvery feather of an ore, painstakingly separated from blood-red bauxite. It was born to fly—and it will lift the settlement toward the world above the clouds.

Coal.name: Coal
Coal.description: The black remains of prehistoric forests, buried deep for a hundred million years. Every furnace, every flame in the settlement burns a forgotten geological age.

Oil.name: Oil
Oil.description: The earth's dark blood, thick and restless. It fuels engines, weaves into plastic, lights the sky—blessing and curse in equal measure.

Crystal.name: Crystal
Crystal.description: A perfect geometric accident of the crust. Rarer than steel, purer than gold—the settlement's future hides within its glittering facets.

Food.name: Food
Food.description: The settlement's simplest and cruelest currency. A single grain can feed a worker—or become the leash that controls his every breath.

IronIngot.name: Iron Ingot
IronIngot.description: Ore dies in the flame—and is reborn in the flame. The silver-gray ingot cools heavily, waiting to be forged into bone and wing.

CopperIngot.name: Copper Ingot
CopperIngot.description: A dark-red metallic flower blooming in the crucible. Soft, malleable, conductive—the most sensitive nerve ending of industry's body.

SteelPlate.name: Steel Plate
SteelPlate.description: A covenant of iron and carbon, tempered in infernal heat. Cold, rigid, unyielding—the spine of towers, the shell of weapons, the will of the settlement.

Glass.name: Glass
Glass.description: Sand melts into transparent tears at a thousand degrees. It pours light into gloomy workshops and lets the overseers watch every frame of labor.

Plastic.name: Plastic
Plastic.description: A white miracle born from black oil. Light enough to float, tough enough to wrap the world—a civilization woven from carbon chains.

Chemicals.name: Chemicals
Chemicals.description: Alchemy at the molecular level. Corrode, catalyze, synthesize—every drop of reagent might sprout, blossom, or detonate.

CircuitBoard.name: Circuit Board
CircuitBoard.description: A silver maze etched onto a green substrate. No flesh, yet it thinks—the settlement's first step toward intelligence.

Motor.name: Motor
Motor.description: An iron core wrapped in copper wire, awakened by current. Its low hum is the heartbeat of industrial civilization.

Sensor.name: Sensor
Sensor.description: The settlement's outstretched nerve endings. It tastes heat, pressure, light, and sound—teaching cold machines how to see.

Gear.name: Gear
Gear.description: Interlocking steel discs passing rotation from one place to another. They are the silent relay runners in the settlement's mechanical body.

Battery.name: Battery
Battery.description: Energy imprisoned in a chemical cage, awaiting its moment of release. Every battery is a small piece of daylight stored in the dark.

Generator.name: Generator
Generator.description: A colossal engine that translates physical motion into the pulse of civilization. It roars, it trembles—it pumps life into the settlement.

Microchip.name: Microchip
Microchip.description: Sand tamed into silicon, silicon carved into a city's nerve center. In a space the size of a fingernail, a trillion thoughts occur every second.

QuantumComputer.name: Quantum Computer
QuantumComputer.description: In a void near absolute zero, the tides of probability are harnessed as computation. It ponders questions no human mind can frame.

Robot.name: Robot
Robot.description: For the first time, a steel frame contains movement. They need no food, no rest—only orders.

Nanobot.name: Nanobot
Nanobot.description: Invisible to the eye, yet swimming through the bloodstream. A machine the size of a dust speck can weave miracles stronger than spider silk.

Antimatter.name: Antimatter
Antimatter.description: The mirror side of matter—the most violent energy in the cosmos. A single gram can light a city... or erase it from every map.

DarkMatter.name: Dark Matter
DarkMatter.description: Unseen, untouched, yet it holds galaxies together. When the settlement learns to touch it back, humanity ceases to be a cosmic spectator.

TimeCrystal.name: Time Crystal
TimeCrystal.description: An exotic structure that never decays in the river of time. It obeys neither cause nor entropy—a hairline crack in the edifice of physics.

Spaceship.name: Spaceship
Spaceship.description: The settlement's ark. When this planet's resources are bled dry, it will carry the last hope into an endless sea of stars.

Corpse.name: Corpse
Corpse.description: Once a living worker, now a pile of organic material awaiting conversion. On the settlement's ledger, the dead are merely another resource class.

Maggot.name: Maggot
Maggot.description: Tiny creatures writhing in rotting flesh, feeding on death. In the settlement's underground labs, they gnaw a path toward the future in the dark.
